references.text: Moses exhorts the people to keep all of God's commands and statutes, which is a recurring theme in Deuteronomy.
Moses gathers Israel and commands them to listen to the Lord's commands and statutes.
Moses gives the people the command to keep all the commands and statutes, with a promise of blessing.
An exhortation to keep all the commands that Moses orders them on that day.
Introduction to the specific laws that Israel is to follow in the land.
Moses and the elders convey the Lord's words to the people, and the people promise to obey.
Moses conveys the Lord's commands to the people, and they promise to obey all the Lord's words.
Joshua carries out what Moses had commanded in Deuteronomy 27 and builds an altar on Mount Ebal.
